event_characterization.classification_disclaimer: No astrophysical classification claimed from non-learned features alone.

limitations: Production anomaly ensemble (Autoencoder + Mahalanobis + Energy) was calibrated strictly on synthetic transients.
Multimodal architecture expects co-temporal difference cutouts; real-ZTF light curve alerts lack image data.
Controlled zero-shot real-ZTF evaluation on 106 frozen benchmark objects demonstrated AUROC = 0.3859 due to severe domain shift.
Production decision threshold (0.65) is unvalidated for astronomical anomaly discovery on real photometric data.
Light-curve-first investigation must proceed without asserting uncalibrated anomaly scores.
anomaly_assessment.domain_gap_notes: The production anomaly detector is NOT validated for real ZTF light curves. Scores are suppressed to prevent scientific overclaiming. Light-curve-first downstream reasoning proceeds using non-learned physical characterization.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Cataclysmic Variable (CV) / Dwarf Nova Outburst
contradictory_evidence: Lacks spectroscopic confirmation of accretion disk emission lines
candidate_hypotheses.justification: High-amplitude repetitive or rapid outburst (rise=0.1d, decline=1.9d) consistent with disk accretion instability.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: High-cadence time-series to detect orbital modulation / superhumps and recurrence.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Stellar Flare / Chromospheric Outburst
contradictory_evidence: Outburst duration longer than canonical M-dwarf impulsive flare (hours)
candidate_hypotheses.justification: Rapid rise phase followed by radiative cooling damping.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: Quiescent optical spectroscopy to detect M-dwarf molecular bands.

candidate_hypotheses.name: Fast Optical Transient (FBOT)
contradictory_evidence: High galactic latitude and persistent quiescent star indicate galactic origin
candidate_hypotheses.justification: Rapid evolutionary timescale matching fast optical transient phase space.
candidate_hypotheses.distinguishing_criteria: Radio follow-up to search for synchrotron relativistic emission.

recommended_observations.scientific_rationale: Missing i-band measurements prevent color temperature and extinction determinations.
Disambiguate competing scientific hypotheses ('Cataclysmic Variable (CV) / Dwarf Nova Outburst') via spectral line identification and redshift determination.
recommended_observations.information_gap: Zero spectroscopic observations available; physical expansion velocities and composition unconstrained

recommended_observations.scientific_rationale: Constrain radioactive decay tail slope (Co-56 vs circumstellar interaction) or confirm quiescent return.
recommended_observations.information_gap: Post-peak light curve decline rate unconstrained at late epochs

limitations: Anomaly scores are suppressed: multimodal ensemble was trained on synthetic data with co-temporal difference images.
Real ZTF input is processed through the Light-Curve-First pathway without image-modality fusion.
Hypotheses reflect physical heuristics and retrieved literature, not automated ML classification.
Redshift, host galaxy associations, and absolute luminosities are unconstrained without external catalog queries.
Production checkpoint remained strictly frozen (no retraining, no fine-tuning, no threshold alteration).
